packageRules.description: One pull request for the Bazel module dependencies, which appear in both MODULE.bazel files.
e2e/bcr_test depends on this module by name so that it exercises the published artifact. That version tracks releases of this repository, not an upstream dependency.
The mutation engine drives every aspect action, and the runner reimplements its mutation key, so upgrades need the test suite to vouch for them.
Workflow actions are low risk and verified by the same CI that gates everything else.

customManagers.description: Keep .bazelversion current; Renovate has no built-in manager for it.
